prompt: An airport terminal with travelers and staff. A security officer is standing next to an X-ray machine. A passenger places her bag on the conveyor belt that leads into the machine. A gate agent is checking boarding passes for a line of passengers. The line contains four business travelers, and the number of vacation travelers is two fewer than the number of business travelers. A pilot, wearing his cap, is pulling his rolling suitcase toward the gate. The pilot is taller than the gate agent. A flight attendant is pushing a cart past passengers who are sitting in the waiting area. The cart has two coffee cups on its top shelf and a number of water bottles on its bottom shelf; the number of water bottles is three times the number of coffee cups. A traveler has her phone connected to a power station that is positioned between two rows of seats. Her laptop, which is thinner than her rolling suitcase nearby, is on the seat next to her.
